autumn_budget_2024__capital_gains_main_r.decision: cos d1344 (Max, 2026-10-15): W6 chooses the reading supported by law, records its evidence, and lands on independent review.

law.title: Finance Act 2025, section 7: Capital gains tax rates
law.effect: The main rates increase from 10% and 20% to 18% and 24% for disposals on or after 30 October 2024.

autumn_budget_2024__capital_gains_main_r.intent: Keep the installed engine's fiscal_year_blend treatment. Reverse to pre-announcement main rates for the whole of FY2024-25, represented by period 2024; FY2023-24 stays unchanged. At a statutory reprocessing entry point the annual windows are submitted as 6 April to 5 April fiscal-year windows.
limitations: The engine pools gains rather than distinguishing their statutory types.
Business Asset Disposal Relief and Investors' Relief changes remain unreversed.
